answer: Standing erodes. Each epoch the ledger measures how much of an identity attested work is still cited by others, and anything uncited for three epochs becomes hollow and is carved away. There is no way to store credit in a private vault: only citations from outside the identity own cluster keep the stone intact. A karst landscape forms where soft claims have already dissolved, leaving pillars of verified work, and a garden of clones erodes back to the seed it grew from.
